canonical_statement: For every number field K, there exists a finite abelian Galois extension H/K, unramified at every finite prime, such that Gal(H/K) is isomorphic to the ideal class group of K and every finite everywhere-unramified abelian extension of K in the comparison universe embeds into H over K.

conclusion: H/K is abelian Galois and unramified at all nonzero prime ideals of its ring of integers; its K-automorphism group is isomorphic to ClassGroup (O K); every finite unramified abelian M/K in universe uM has a K-algebra embedding into H.
